job.job_description:
Start your career building generative-AI and machine-learning solutions for enterprise clients, with structured mentoring from senior engineers.


Responsibilities

Develop components of RAG and LLM-based applications
Write clean, tested Python services and APIs
Prepare data and build evaluation sets
Integrate AI features with client systems
Participate in code reviews, stand-ups and client demos


Requirements

B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA in Computer Science or related field (recent graduates welcome)
Strong Python and data-structures fundamentals
Understanding of ML basics and LLM concepts
Good communication skills in English


Nice to have

Internship or project experience with LLMs or ML
Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)
SQL knowledge


Tech stack

Python
FastAPI
LLM APIs
LangChain
Vector databases
SQL
Git
Docker


Work authorization

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in India.
